detail.note: Status of the verdict-join WIN hits covering residual rows: each is a depth-10 single-order (andclose=true) engine verdict from the cost-lane raw batches in the K0863 cache corpus (raw bit_line loss=true, capped=false, terminalStoneRange present, in-file pilot_d6 control loss=false). The lane runner is the published repo-verbatim class4_child1_runner_v16.ts with depth-10 andclose=1 and an in-file pilot d6 control line; the heaviest of these bits were additionally re-solved node-exact in a separate process (determinism_rerun_node_exact in the lane sweep record). They are NOT receipt-closure certificates yet: closing their rows via the receipt-fold mechanism requires certificate extraction (child = root minus the lowest set bit) plus independent dual verification (BigInt 3x3 / Bareiss 4x4) of each extracted root.  Until then the covered rows are counted as pending-win only, and the 39-root live witness plan (maximum matching 39 over the 78 residual rows) still fully covers all residual rows, so the coverage bookkeeping of this record never depends on treating these 4 hits as closed.

interpretation_guard: REFUTED-D10 is not a LOSS proof; depth-10 saturation labels are experimental node-identity judgements inside the runner v16/v17 move model.
A fold is row-coverage bookkeeping and says nothing about game-theoretic values.
Windfall candidates and witness roots are conditional depth-10 plans, not certificates; closure requires certificate extraction plus independent dual verification.
Stranded rows at this scope do not preclude closure by multi-cover candidates, unsafe candidates, add-two-stones expansion, deeper search or other out-of-scope mechanisms.
The standard 11x11 empty board, two-stone roots {49,60}/{59,60}, S2 {59,60}, and classes 1/2/4 remain UNKNOWN.
